Raydar is recruiting for a fast-growing software company seeking a customer-facing Forward Deployed Software Engineer. The role owns client deployments from discovery through shipped solutions, combining full-stack development, AI-driven automation, integrations, demos, site visits, and ongoing technical account ownership.
Management Consulting
Responsibilities
Tailor the platform's data intake and integrations to each new customer's file formats, systems and workflows so they reach value quickly
Run discovery sessions and site visits with experienced operators, and feed what you learn back into the core product
Build prototypes, internal tools and new workflows quickly, then harden the ones that prove useful
Create AI-driven automations that replace repetitive manual work you observe customers doing
Prepare and deliver demos, join customer visits and help convert pilots into paying accounts
Own the technical relationship after a sale, making sure customers get value and identifying the next problem to solve
Qualification
Full-Stack Development
Backend Development
Python
TypeScript
Production Software Development
AI Coding Assistants
Legacy System Integration
Required
1 to 5 years of full-stack or backend engineering experience, using Python and TypeScript
A track record of shipping production software that real users rely on
A degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, math, physics or engineering
Genuine enjoyment of working directly with customers
Ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to non-technical buyers
Preferred
Evidence of building something from scratch, such as personal projects, a venture you launched or original open source work
Prior customer-facing engineering experience, such as forward-deployed, sales or solutions engineering
Good judgment about when to ship quickly and when to build carefully
Regular use of AI coding assistants in your daily work
Notable achievement in a competitive pursuit outside of your engineering career
Familiarity with hardware, electrical, procurement or supply chain work, or with legacy system integrations

Equity
Health coverage
Paid time off
